target_customer: Knowledge workers and teams whose files are spread across many cloud work apps
problem: Employees lose time finding and organizing files scattered across Drive, Dropbox, Slack and other cloud apps; Clew offered one search and organization layer.
business_model: Freemium desktop app moving to team subscriptions (not confirmed by a source)
product_category: Universal cloud search and file organization

founders.name: Udara Jayawardena
founders.background_notes: Appears as maker on Product Hunt as Udara Jay

founders.name: Haish Sucharda
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; a Product Hunt commenter named Haishan Qian may be the same person, not confirmed

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing and searching across many third party cloud APIs with a native desktop client (reportedly Rust with Tauri) is moderate engineering with many integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on third party APIs and could be matched by the platforms or enterprise search vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sourced account; I found no dated evidence of an incumbent response.

market_need_then: Cloud app sprawl was a known pain; Clew 1.0 drew 169 upvotes on Product Hunt on 2020-06-23 and Clew 2.0 drew 269 on 2021-06-16, suggesting early interest, but no spend or revenue data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used clew.ai (host did not resolve from the research environment).
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches in June 2020 and June 2021 with active comment threads; many unrelated products share the name Clew.

brand_strength.rationale: Short evocative word but shared by several unrelated products, with only Product Hunt traction as brand evidence.

pivots.why: Product Hunt launch copy for Clew 2.0 describes a digital workspace; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: YC lists Clew as acquired, but I found no acquirer, date or price in any news source, and Dealroom only repeats the acquired label. The company launched on Product Hunt in June 2020 with 169 upvotes and relaunched as Clew 2.0 in June 2021, then disappeared from sources. The cause and form of the exit are not public, so no factors are assigned.
notes: clew.ai did not resolve (ENOTFOUND), so the site is treated as unreachable or dead. Funding unverified: Startupintros shows a 20M Series B (2020-01-16) and Seedtable shows 40.5M, and CB Insights shows a 0.1M seed with a Seoul address; these records conflict and appear to describe different companies named Clew, so none is recorded. Competitor search returned only undated alternative lists and later Glean comparisons, so the dated list is empty.
